welcome.greeting:
Hello{{name}}, and welcome to Assur'Assistance. 👋

I can prepare a travel insurance quote for you in just a few questions.
welcome.menu: What would you like to do?
welcome.languageHint: At any time, write FRANCAIS to continue in French.
welcome.resumePrompt: We had already started a quote for you. Would you like to pick up where we left off?
welcome.greetingClaims:
Hello{{name}}, and welcome to Assur'Assistance. 👋

I can prepare a travel insurance quote for you, or help you report and track a claim.
welcome.hintBuy: Quote and cover in a few questions
welcome.hintClaim: Report an incident during your trip
welcome.hintAgent: Get in touch with a person

personalInfo.prompt:
To begin, send me in a single message:

*Last name*, *First name*, *Date of birth*

For example: Ali, Saif, 12/03/1990
personalInfo.promptSimple: Let's do this more simply, one question at a time.

nationality.prompt: What is your *nationality*? Write the country name.
nationality.candidates: Several countries match. Which one is right?
nationality.notFound: I could not find that country. Try writing the full name, or choose from the list.

passport.prompt: What is your *passport number* (or ID number)?

destination.prompt: Where are you *travelling to*? Write the country name.
destination.candidates: Several destinations match. Which one is right?
destination.notFound: I could not find that destination. Try again, or choose from the list.

travelDates.prompt:
What are your *travel dates*?

Send departure and return, for example: 01/10/2026, 15/10/2026

email.prompt: What is your *email address*? We will send your certificate there.

phone.prompt: We will use this WhatsApp number ({{number}}) as your contact number. Is that correct?
phone.otherPrompt: Send the number to use, including the country code. For example: +225 07 18 92 31 94

plan.prompt: Here are the plans available for your trip:
plan.none: No plan is available for this combination of destination and duration. An agent will contact you.

review.title: Thank you. Here is a summary of your details:
review.question: Is everything correct?
review.editPrompt: Which detail would you like to correct?

quote.title: 🛡️ *Your quote {{reference}}*
quote.question: Would you like to confirm this quote?
quote.confirmed:
✅ Perfect. Your quote *{{reference}}* has been saved.

An agent will contact you to complete payment, and your certificate will then be emailed to you.
quote.cancelled: Your request has been cancelled. Write *RESTART* at any time to start a new quote.
quote.ineligible: Given the age of the insured, this quote requires a specific exemption. An agent will contact you.
quote.noPrice: I cannot calculate a premium for this combination. An agent will contact you.

payment.choose: How would you like to pay?
payment.askPhone:
Which {{provider}} number would you like to pay from?

Send the number with its country code, for example 2250700000000.
Reply *1* to use this WhatsApp number.
payment.invalidPhone: That number does not look valid. Send it with the country code, for example 2250700000000.
payment.wrongPrefix: That number is not a {{provider}} number. {{provider}} numbers start with {{prefixes}}.
payment.prompt:
📲 A payment request for *{{amount}}* has been sent to {{msisdn}}.

Confirm it on your handset. We will message you as soon as it goes through.
payment.waiting: We are still waiting for the confirmation on your handset. It usually takes under a minute.
payment.success:
✅ Payment received.

Your policy *{{policy}}* has been issued. Your certificate is on its way.
payment.successNoPolicy: ✅ Payment received. We are finalising your policy and will send it in a moment.
payment.noProviders: No mobile money option is available for your country at the moment. An adviser will contact you to complete the payment.
payment.startFailed: We could not start the payment. Try again in a moment, or choose another operator.
payment.retryPrompt: What would you like to do?
payment.cancelled: Payment cancelled. Your quote *{{reference}}* is still valid — write to us whenever you want to pick it up again.

failed.insufficient_funds: ❌ Not enough balance on that account.
failed.customer_cancelled: ❌ You cancelled the request on your handset.
failed.customer_timeout: ⌛ The request expired without a confirmation.
failed.invalid_number: ❌ That number is not registered with this operator.
failed.limit_exceeded: ❌ The amount is above the limit allowed on that account.
failed.duplicate_transaction: ❌ An identical request is already in progress.
failed.provider_unavailable: ❌ The operator is not responding right now.
failed.configuration_error: ❌ This payment method is unavailable at the moment.
failed.unknown: ❌ The payment did not go through.

payment.expired: ⌛ The payment request expired without a confirmation.

error.required: I need this detail to continue. Could you send it again?
error.name_too_short: That name looks too short. Could you send it in full?
error.name_too_long: That name is too long. Could you shorten it?
error.name_has_digits: A name does not contain numbers. Could you send it again?
error.name_invalid: That name contains characters that are not allowed. Could you send it again?
error.passport_too_short: That number looks too short. Could you check it?
error.passport_too_long: That number looks too long. Could you check it?
error.passport_invalid: Use letters and numbers only, with no special characters.
error.passport_no_digit: A passport number normally contains at least one digit. Could you check it?
error.email_invalid: That email address does not look valid. Could you send it again?
error.email_too_long: That email address is too long.
error.phone_invalid: That number does not look valid. Use digits only, including the country code.
error.phone_no_country_code: Please include the country code, for example +225…
error.dob_unparseable: I did not understand that date. Please write it as DD/MM/YYYY, for example 12/03/1990.
error.dob_future: A date of birth cannot be in the future. Could you check it?
error.dob_implausible: That year of birth looks unusual. Could you check it?
error.date_unparseable: I did not understand that date. Please write it as DD/MM/YYYY.
error.dates_out_of_order: The return date must be after the departure date.
error.dates_too_long: Cover is available for up to 365 days.
error.start_in_past: The departure date cannot be in the past.
error.gender_invalid: Please choose Male, Female or Other.
error.grouped_ambiguous: To avoid a mistake, separate the details with commas: Last name, First name, Date of birth.
error.grouped_incomplete: One detail is missing. Please send all three: Last name, First name, Date of birth.
error.generic: I did not understand. Could you rephrase?
error.tooManyRetries: I am having trouble recording this detail. Let's try a simpler way.

certificate.sending: Sending the certificate for policy *{{policy}}* again. It will arrive in a moment. 📄
certificate.none: I cannot find any policy linked to this number. If you bought from a different number, write *AGENT* and a person will help you.
certificate.notReady: Policy *{{policy}}* does not have a certificate available yet. Write *AGENT* and someone will sort it out right away.
certificate.alreadySent: Your certificate was just sent — look a little further up in this conversation. If it did not arrive, write *AGENT*.

session.expired: Our previous conversation has expired. Write *HELLO* to start a new quote.
session.expiredResume: Our previous conversation expired, but I kept your details. Would you like to resume?
session.noPrevious: We are at the start, so there is nothing before this question.

help.text:
Here is what you can write at any time:

*RESTART* — start again from the beginning
*BACK* — go back to the previous question
*HELP* — show this message
*CERTIFICATE* — get your certificate again
*AGENT* — be put in touch with a person
*FRANCAIS* — continuer en français

agent.requested: Noted. An agent will take over as soon as possible.
agent.withNumber: Noted. You can also reach an agent directly on {{number}}.
agent.resume: In the meantime we can carry on. Write *RESTART* if you would rather begin again.

language.switched: Great, I will continue in English. 🇬🇧

unsupported.image: I cannot read images. Could you type your answer instead?
unsupported.audio: I cannot listen to voice notes. Could you type your answer instead?
unsupported.video: I cannot watch videos. Could you type your answer instead?
unsupported.document: I cannot open documents here. Could you type your answer instead?
unsupported.location: Thank you, but I cannot use a location. Could you write the country name?
unsupported.generic: I can only handle text and the buttons I offer. Could you type your answer?
unsupported.emptyMessage: I did not receive anything. Could you send your answer again?
unsupported.tooLong: That message is very long. Could you answer more briefly?

system.unavailable: The quote service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
system.error: A technical error occurred on our side. We are fixing it; please try again in a few minutes.

claim.notAvailable: Reporting a claim on WhatsApp will be available soon. In the meantime, an agent can help you{{number}}.
claim.paymentPending: A payment is in progress in this conversation. You can report a claim as soon as it is confirmed or cancelled.
claim.switchConfirm:
You have a quote in progress. Do you want to report a claim now?

Your quote is kept: you can pick it up again afterwards.
claim.resumePrompt: You had started reporting a claim (policy {{policy}}). Would you like to pick up where you left off?
claim.intro:
Let's report your claim. 📝

First I'll check your insurance policy.
claim.identifyPrompt: What is your *policy number*{{cardHint}}? It is on your insurance certificate, for example AA-2026-000123.
claim.identifierInvalid: That number doesn't look right. Please copy it exactly as it appears on your certificate.
claim.passportPrompt: Thank you. What is the *passport or ID number* on the policy?
claim.notFound:
I couldn't verify those details. Please check the policy number and the passport number, then try again.

Attempts left: {{left}}.
claim.locked: For your security, verification is paused for {{minutes}} minutes. An agent can help you{{number}}.
claim.expired:
Your policy {{policy}} ended on {{date}} and can no longer be used to report a claim.

You can buy new cover in a few minutes, or speak to an agent.
claim.cancelledPolicy: Policy {{policy}} has been cancelled and cannot be used to report a claim. An agent will get back to you{{number}}.
claim.unpaid: Policy {{policy}} has not been paid yet and cannot be used to report a claim. An agent can help you{{number}}.
claim.outOfWindow: The deadline for reporting ({{days}} days after the incident) has passed for policy {{policy}}. An agent can look at your situation{{number}}.
claim.notStarted: Policy {{policy}} only starts on {{date}}. A claim can only be reported from that date.
claim.noDates: I can't check the cover dates for policy {{policy}}. An agent will help you{{number}}.
claim.categoryPrompt: What kind of claim do you want to report?
claim.uncovered: Your plan ({{plan}}) does not include this cover. Choose another type of claim, or write *AGENT* to talk to a person.
claim.incidentDatePrompt: On what date did the incident happen? Please write it as DD/MM/YYYY.
claim.dateInvalid: I didn't understand that date. Please write it as DD/MM/YYYY, for example 05/11/2026.
claim.dateFuture: That date is in the future. On what date did the incident happen?
claim.dateOutsideCover: Your policy covers {{start}} to {{end}}: that date is outside the cover. Check the date, buy new cover, or speak to an agent.
claim.dateOutOfWindow: This incident is more than {{days}} days old: the reporting deadline has passed. An agent can look at your situation{{number}}.
claim.countryPrompt: In which country did the incident happen?
claim.cityInvalid: Please give the name of the city (2 to 80 characters).
claim.fieldRequired: This information is needed. Could you give it?
claim.fieldNumber: Please write a number, for example 3.
claim.fieldRange: Please give a value between {{min}} and {{max}}.
claim.fieldTooLong: That answer is too long ({{max}} characters at most).
claim.fieldChoice: Please choose one of the options offered.
claim.descriptionPrompt: Describe what happened in a few sentences (at least {{min}} characters): what happened, where, and what you have done so far.
claim.descriptionTooShort: Your description is a little short ({{count}} characters). Please add some details: at least {{min}} characters.
claim.descriptionTooLong: Your description is too long ({{count}} characters, {{max}} at most). Could you shorten it?
claim.urgent: ⚠️ Your situation seems urgent: your claim will be handled as a priority.
claim.urgentNumber: ⚠️ Your situation seems urgent: your claim will be handled as a priority. You can also call an agent right now on {{number}}.
claim.documentsWaiting: Send your documents as a photo or a PDF, or write *DONE* when you have finished.
claim.documentReceived: ✅ Received: {{name}} ({{count}} document(s) in total). Send the next one, or tap *Done*.
claim.documentPending: 📥 Received ({{count}} document(s) in total). It is being processed, nothing more to do on your side. Send the next one, or tap *Done*.
claim.documentAttached: 📎 File received: I'm adding it to your claim.
claim.documentTooEarly: Thank you! Keep this file: I'll ask for your documents a little later, once your policy is checked.
claim.documentTooMany: You have already sent {{max}} documents, the most one claim can take. Tap *Done* to continue.
claim.documentTooLarge: This file is too large ({{max}} MB at most). Please send a lighter photo or a smaller PDF.
claim.documentBadType: I can only accept photos (JPG, PNG) and PDFs. Could you send this document again in one of those formats?
claim.documentCorrupted: I can't read this file: it looks incomplete or damaged. Could you send it again?
claim.documentFailed: I couldn't receive this file. Could you send it again?
claim.editPrompt: What would you like to change?
claim.consentDeclined: Without your agreement we cannot send the claim. You can change it, submit it after accepting, or cancel it.
claim.submitted:
✅ Your claim has been recorded.

Claim number: *{{reference}}*

A claims handler will review it and get back to you. To track your claim, write *TRACK {{reference}}*.
claim.submitFailed: Your claim could not be recorded just now. Nothing is lost: tap *Submit* again in a few minutes, or write *AGENT*.
claim.restarted: Starting the claim again from the beginning. 🔄
claim.noPrevious: We are at the start of the claim: there is nothing before this question.
claim.trackPrompt: What is your claim number? For example SIN-2026-000123.
claim.trackNotFound: I can't find a claim with that number for your WhatsApp number. Please check the reference.
claim.anythingElse: Write *MENU* to see what else I can do.
claim.help:
While reporting a claim you can write at any time:

*BACK* — go back to the previous question
*RESTART* — start the claim again from the beginning
*CANCEL* — abandon the claim
*AGENT* — talk to a person
*FRANCAIS* — continuer en français
